materials.name: Stone
materials.searchTags: stone rock rocks material building pickaxe mine respawn buy meriam crime
materials.zhSearchTags: 石头 石块 岩石 材料 建造 镐 矿洞 刷新 购买 市政厅 犯罪
materials.summary: Collect the loose stone available on land you own first. A reliable repeatable source after that supply is exhausted has not yet been verified.
materials.zhSummary: 先收集自己土地上的散落石头。初始石头耗尽后，可靠的可重复来源仍待验证。

facts.text: Current-build players report gathering loose stone from ranch land and eventually exhausting the visible supply.
facts.zhText: 当前版本玩家报告可以收集牧场土地上的散落石头，但可见的初始储量会被采完。

facts.text: Taking stone from land you do not own can be treated as theft and trigger fines or jail; neighboring plots are not a safe free supply.
facts.zhText: 从不属于你的土地拿石头可能被判定为偷窃并触发罚款或坐牢；不要把邻近地块当成免费来源。

facts.text: Reliable repeatable Stone supply is still being verified. Mines are not available in the reviewed Early Access build.
facts.zhText: 可靠的可重复石头来源仍待验证。当前审查的抢先体验版本尚未开放矿洞。

materials.name: Wood Log
materials.searchTags: wood log timber tree chop charcoal building red tent recipe
materials.zhSearchTags: 原木 木材 木头 砍树 木炭 建造 红帐篷 配方
materials.summary: Wood Logs are the base material for early construction and the input used by the community charcoal method.
materials.zhSummary: 原木是早期建造材料，也是社区木炭制作方法所使用的原料。

facts.text: Current community reports obtain Wood Logs by cutting trees; the retained reports do not establish tree respawn timing or ownership rules.
facts.zhText: 当前社区报告通过砍树获得原木；现有资料无法确认树木刷新时间或土地所有权规则。

facts.text: Launch-build footage shows a Red Tent recipe requiring 10 Wood Logs and 8 Stone; it does not prove other recipe costs.
facts.zhText: 首发版本视频显示红帐篷配方需要 10 个原木和 8 个石头；这不能证明其他配方的材料数量。

materials.name: Hay
materials.searchTitle: Where to get Hay for chickens
materials.zhSearchTitle: 鸡饲料干草在哪里获得
materials.searchTags: hay grass bush crates barrels chicken feed trough silo animal food
materials.zhSearchTags: 干草 草 灌木 木箱 桶 鸡饲料 食槽 筒仓 动物食物
materials.summary: Hay is chicken feed. The public current-build gathering route is still based on a single traceable player report.
materials.zhSummary: 干草是鸡饲料。当前公开获取路线仍主要来自一条可追踪的玩家报告。

facts.text: An official moderator answer identifies hay as chicken feed; place it in the interior trough or load a connected silo for automation.
facts.zhText: 官方版主确认干草是鸡饲料；可放进鸡舍内部食槽，或装入已连接的筒仓用于自动喂食。

facts.text: One current-build report gets hay by cutting bushes or searching crates and barrels on NPC farms. Treat this as a route to test, not a guaranteed drop table.
facts.zhText: 一条当前版本报告称可通过砍灌木，或搜索 NPC 农场的木箱和桶获得干草。它是待复测路线，不是已确认掉落表。

materials.name: Charcoal
materials.searchTags: charcoal coal burn logs torch fire extinguisher building material
materials.zhSearchTags: 木炭 煤 原木 燃烧 火把 灭火器 建造 材料
materials.summary: The community route is to burn Wood Logs and extinguish the fire before collecting the resulting charcoal. Work away from buildings and crops.
materials.zhSummary: 社区路线是燃烧原木，在收集生成的木炭前用灭火器灭火。操作时远离建筑和作物。

facts.text: Multiple current-build players describe the same core route: place or cut Wood Logs, ignite them, wait for the material change, then use a fire extinguisher before collecting Charcoal.
facts.zhText: 多名当前版本玩家描述了相同核心路线：放下或砍出原木，点燃并等待材料变化，再用灭火器灭火后收集木炭。

facts.text: The moderator separately identifies the fire extinguisher as the intended way to put out fires. The retained evidence does not lock down one keyboard control or an exact burn timer.
facts.zhText: 官方版主另行说明灭火器是预期的灭火方式。现有证据不足以锁定唯一键盘操作或精确燃烧计时。

materials.name: Zirconite
materials.searchTitle: Where can I buy Zirconite? Meriam at City Hall
materials.zhSearchTitle: 锆矿在哪里买？市政厅的 Meriam
materials.searchTags: zirconite zerkonite meriam city hall architect buy mine material blueprint
materials.zhSearchTags: 锆矿 Zirconite Zerkonite Meriam 市政厅 建筑师 购买 矿洞 材料 蓝图
materials.summary: Buy Zirconite for now. The official moderator says purchasing is the only current route until mines are implemented.
materials.zhSummary: 现阶段需要购买锆矿。官方版主说明，在矿洞实装前，购买是当前唯一途径。

facts.text: The official moderator says buying Zirconite is the only current option until mines are implemented; do not search for a wild ore route in this build.
facts.zhText: 官方版主说明，在矿洞实装前，购买锆矿是当前唯一途径；这个版本不必寻找野外矿石路线。

facts.text: Multiple current community answers identify Meriam at City Hall as the seller. The retained evidence does not support publishing a stable current price.
facts.zhText: 多条当前社区回答把市政厅的 Meriam 指为卖家。现有证据不足以发布稳定的当前价格。
